## Checklist

- [ ] `bun tsc -b --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `bun run lint` passes
- [ ] E2E suites pass against a running server (`bun run test:all`)
- [ ] No secrets or keys committed; new env vars documented in the README table
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes

_Agents and code-assist tools are welcome. Keep commits self-authored — do not add `Co-Authored-By:` trailers for tools, and sign commits with your own git identity (set `user.name`/`user.email` before committing)._
